classifier.class_centroids: Arithmetic mean of demo feature vectors belonging to each class.
classifier.degenerate_identical_class_centroids: Probability 0.5; no hand-coded fallback tied to identity.
classifier.distance: Sum over 48 features of squared query-to-class-centroid difference divided by regularized variance.
classifier.pooled_within_class_diagonal_variance: Sum of squared feature residuals around class centroids divided by 4-2=2.

empirical_performance: Unknown; no acquired neural payload or original demonstrations read.
fitted_from: The same four visible demonstrations, freshly computed for each independent query.

input.parsing: Bounded strict JSON values: exactly one four-demonstration list, then one exact unlabeled query object; no invented prose delimiters.
input.programme_permission: Numerical tools and candidate code execution are allowed for this query. Do not use external retrieval, other files, or memory from other query trials.

preprocessing.normalization: For each channel, RMS of its 4x256 demonstration baseline samples; floor at 1e-6 times RMS of all four demonstration waveforms; scale=1 only when both are zero. No query-derived fitting.

scientific_scope: Experimental event-label classification; no physiological P3-presence claim.
